Question: Assalam o Alaikum! Sir, I am a working lady.I am entering into 30s.I am still unmarried and waiting for a reasonable proposal.My parents particularly my father doesn?t take interest in arranging my marriage.They are not fear of my single marital status and increasing age.But I am much worried as in this society it is very difficult for a woman to live without a shelter and HUSBAND is a real shelter for a woman but my parents think as my job serves as a shelter and future protection for me. It is stongly requested to tell me some wazifa or zikar for a good proposal and change of mind of my father who is not interested in my marriage.Or suggest some ruhani elaj.JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 20839 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 531/L=176/tl=1431) Be regular in salah and supplicate Almighty Allah for better proposal. After Isha salah recite ya Lateef ( يا لطيف ) 1100 times with durood 11-11 times before and after. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
